desc: New design adds a secure steel safe with combination lock and padded interior to the traditional "Diversion" book design. Don't be fooled by traditional diversion books, the new Bulldog Diversion Book Safe keeps your firearms and valuables hidden from view and safe from accidental access. Unique concept discretely conceals and protects your firearms and valuables. Ideal for use in the home or office. Deluxe foam interior protects valuables from scratches during use. Three wheel combination lock keeps valuables safe while providing easy access. Deluxe steel safe box provides 360 degrees of protection. Brown and Blue color options. Exterior Dimensions - 10.5" x 7.75" x 2.75". Interior Dimensions - 9.25" x 7" x 1.5".
